# MemristiveReservoirBranchPrediction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A branch predictor in microarchitecture that uses a memristor-based reservoir computer to learn temporal patterns in control-flow history. Demonstrates a concrete TCC application where topological memory structures in memristive arrays improve predictive performance over conventional finite-state predictors.
